Terrible, frightful, horrible, formidable; वेल्लद्भैरवरुण्डमुण्डनिकरैर्वीरो
 विधत्ते भुवम्
A form of Śiva (of which 8 kinds are enumerated).
N. of a musical mode (राग) calculated to excite emotions of fear or terror.
N. of a Rāgiṇī in the Hindu musical system.

A girl of 12 or a young girl representing the goddess Durgā at the
 Durgā festival.
+ -ईशः an epithet of Viṣṇu (or Śiva ?); so भैरवतर्जकः.

+ -यातना a sort of purificatory torment inflicted by Bhairava of
 Benares on those who die there, to make their spirits fit for absorption
 into the Supreme Spirit.
